nodes.name: bootstrap.sh
nodes.summary: First-run setup script that installs npm dependencies, copies the .env template, sets up the SQLite database, generates Prisma clients, runs migrations, and seeds a demo tenant in six sequential steps.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses set -euo pipefail for strict error handling; the script is purely imperative with no named functions.

nodes.name: diagnose-prisma-engines.ps1
nodes.summary: Windows diagnostic script that locates all Prisma query_engine-windows.dll.node files under services/ and reports whether each is currently locked by another process, helping resolve EPERM errors during prisma generate.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses System.IO.File::Open with FileShare.None to test for file lock — a Windows-specific technique not available on Unix.

nodes.name: Test-EngineLocked
nodes.summary: Attempts to open a file with exclusive read-write access and no sharing; returns true if the file is locked by another process, false otherwise.

nodes.name: scaffold-ai.ps1
nodes.summary: PowerShell scaffold generator that creates a new AI microservice directory under ai/ with a FastAPI main.py, requirements.txt, a multi-stage Dockerfile, and a README stub, parameterized by service name, port, and description.
nodes.languageNotes: Generates Python FastAPI service code inline as heredoc strings; the Dockerfile uses a two-stage build (builder + runner) with a non-root cosmos user for security.
